strategy_preferred: local selective text-only ordinary LoRA on 8-bit training base; RTX 5060 8 GiB fit unmeasured
qlora_status: 4-bit NF4 deferred to a separate bounded canary only; Qwen3.5 guide discourages this path; no automatic fallback run
target_module_policy: Enumerate actual text modules; test export mapping before selection. Freeze vision, base, embeddings and lm_head. Do not blindly use all-linear.
sequence_policy: Matched tokenizer must confirm complete input plus target fits; no truncation. 2048 allowed only after measured fit/time canary.
precision: 8-bit frozen base with BF16 compute/adapters only if hardware/library/export canary passes
partial_accumulation_policy: Normalize by actual window size; two 42-record epochs at accumulation four have at most 22 updates.
scratch_canary_policy: Discard scratch updates, record them separately, and reinitialize seeded pilot adapter; all GPU canary work counts toward experiment wall time.
timing_policy: Stage and total deadlines are hard limits, not ETAs. First GPU load starts clock; no resets for failure/fallback. Preparation, review and retrieval completion are not promised within two hours.
forecast_policy: After warmup: 1.25 * measured p95 microbatch seconds * remaining complete-pass microbatches + 60 seconds overhead. Reject pass that exceeds remaining optimization/token budget; watchdog remains authoritative.

public_diagnostics.incomplete_coverage_policy: Report incomplete; do not extend deadline, omit failures or imply production acceptance.

pilot_stop_rule: Stop on any unmet source/review/input/export/gradient/resource gate, failed forecast or deadline, or unsafe/regressing outputs. No automatic second run, offload/cloud detour or timer reset; retain base. Pilot cannot produce ADOPT.
dependencies: runtime-compatible task projections or explicit development-only canary classification
idle existing GPU with live resource measurements
isolated transport/watchdog/telemetry before a model run

export.preferred: one stable startup-loaded adapter through existing backend
export.fallback: merged quantized artifact only after matching provenance and measured comparison
